summary: SOURCE_ONLY bounded critique: fixed plan/count/order, native-entry, null-Part and exact-value/codec derivations are supported, but frozen E1512 policy has one concrete success-shape contradiction if its per-check error:null wording is read literally. Original policy has not passed unchanged. No producer outputs were inspected and no replay, import, tests, vendor/PATH read or measurement was performed; all physical/scientific/semantic acceptance claims remain UNKNOWN.

findings.policy_quote: Each snapshot has10 checks in plan order with original hashes, verified:true, post hashes equal pre, error:null
findings.counterexample: For any source-successful comparison, checks[k] is the exact ordered object {planIndex,post,verified}, with post={rgbaSha256,maskSha256}; it has no own error key. A comparator requiring checks[k].error === null, or requiring the own error key, rejects that genuine source shape. Conversely adding error:null would violate exact source keys/order and missing-versus-null equality. The enclosing snapshot record is where error:null belongs.
findings.minimal_append_only_clarification: Keep original E1512 bytes/hash frozen. Add a separately versioned, hash-bound source-shape addendum stating: snapshot records retain error:null on success; each checks[k] has exactly ordered keys planIndex,post,verified, with no error or pre field; checks[k].post equals enclosing snapshot.pre and verified is true. Do not add/remove any numeric timing exception or change raw-value equality. Root must explicitly select the interpretation/guard before comparator use; R2 does not change policy automatically.

supported_derivations.claim: Timing exclusions are only named leaves; clock formulas are source-derived but are not measurement-science evidence
supported_derivations.evidence: recipe.mjs:239-247 records start/end and elapsed=end-start in completion order; store.mjs:125-126,:381,:388 records roundMs(now()-started). Finite/nonnegative/monotone clock and nested<=outer checks are native-clock admission guards, not explicit validation performed by producer source. Store reads globalThis.performance whereas wrapper imports performance; unchanged ordinary native clock behavior is assumed. No other concrete contradiction found in this bounded inspection, and no clock execution/probe was done.

supported_derivations.claim: Provenance keys must be interpreted per source object, not fabricated from compressed policy prose
supported_derivations.evidence: recipe.mjs:187-200 fixes six suppliedFiles role order. Legacy verifySourceClosure (:176-183) produces {verified,entries}; each physical entry is exactly path,expectedSha256,actualSha256,error (no bytes or per-entry verified). Lenard runtimeHashes (:249-261) produces five entries path,expectedSha256,actualSha256,bytes (no per-entry error/verified; first two expectedSha256 are null). The compressed policy line94 should not be implemented as requiring every listed field on every entry. This is an ambiguity warning, not a second established contradiction.
